description: This Java source file named JsonExamplesProducer.java is responsible for generating and writing various JSON example files related to connectivity commands, responses, view commands, view responses, and exceptions within the Eclipse Ditto project. It constructs example JSON representations of connectivity commands and responses, likely for testing or documentation purposes.

classes.name: JsonExamplesProducer
classes.description: A utility class that generates sample JSON files representing various connectivity commands, responses, and exceptions for testing, documentation, or demonstration purposes within the Eclipse Ditto project.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that initiates the JSON production process, taking the target directory as argument.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Configures the target folder path and triggers JSON generation.

methods.name: produceConnectivityCommands
methods.description: Coordinates the production of various connectivity-related JSON files.

methods.name: produceModifyCommands
methods.description: Generates JSON files for modify commands like test, create, modify, delete, open, and close connection commands.

methods.name: produceModifyResponse
methods.description: Generates JSON response files for the modify commands.

methods.name: produceViewCommands
methods.description: Generates JSON files for view-related commands such as retrieving connection info, status, and metrics.

methods.name: produceViewCommandResponse
methods.description: Creates JSON response files for view commands, including connection info, status, and metrics.

methods.name: produceExceptions
methods.description: Produces JSON files representing various connectivity exception scenarios.

methods.name: writeJson
methods.description: Serializes a Jsonifiable object to JSON and writes to the specified path.
